questions.title: Which districts will hold polling on August 10 in Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election?
questions.background: Pakistan-administered Kashmir's 2026 Legislative Assembly election is scheduled to take place in three phases.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official election-authority records or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the districts where polling takes place on August 10, 2026. Resolution : The answer will be the complete set of districts within Pakistan-administered Kashmir where Legislative Assembly polling opens on that date. Accepted Answer Format : The district names, joined by “and”.
questions.current_reasoning: As of June 18, 2026, the AJK Election Commission still had single-day Legislative Assembly polling set for July 27, 2026, though CEC Justice Ghulam Mustafa Mughal warned JAAC protests (including disruptions in Poonch) could force schedule adjustments. When AJK conducts three-phase elections (as in the 2022 AJK local body polls), polling is organized by its three administrative divisions: Muzaffarabad Division (Muzaffarabad, Neelum, Jhelum Valley), Poonch Division (Poonch, Bagh, Haveli, Sudhnoti), and Mirpur Division (Mirpur, Kotli, Bhimber). With Monday August 10 falling two weeks after July 27 (fitting a weekly Phase 3 slot for Mirpur Division in the 2022 order or a delayed Poonch/Muzaffarabad phase), the three exact divisions take 77% combined, leaving 23% across non-divisional groupings.

questions.title: Which branch of Venezuela's government will the first government–opposition talks after Nicolás Maduro's removal agree to overhaul?
questions.background: Nicolás Maduro was removed from power in January 2026, and Delcy Rodríguez became acting president. Previous negotiations between Venezuela's government and opposition have not produced a lasting political settlement.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from the negotiating parties or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera. Resolution Conditions : Identify the branch of government that both sides agree to comprehensively overhaul during their first formal negotiating round following Maduro's January 2026 removal. The round must conclude by August 31, 2026. An announced agreement is sufficient; implementation is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The common name of the governmental branch, rather than an individual institution or officeholder.
questions.current_reasoning: On June 18, 2026, interim government negotiator Jorge Rodríguez (representing Delcy Rodríguez) and US-backed opposition representative Dinorah Figuera launched the first formal post-Maduro talks, forming a joint technical-political working group. Rebuilding Venezuela's Electoral branch (Poder Electoral / National Electoral Council) is the explicit centerpiece demanded by the US State Department, Secretary Marco Rubio, Figuera, and María Corina Machado's parallel roadmap to enable credible elections. Venezuela's Judicial branch (Poder Judicial / Supreme Court appointments and justice overhaul) is a strong second contender—explicitly included on Figuera's agenda and emphasized by transition analysts—while the remaining three constitutional branches (Legislative, Citizen, and Executive) account for the residual 14%.

questions.title: Which city will be the site of Typhoon Dolphin's first landfall in mainland China in August 2026?
questions.background: Dolphin developed into a typhoon over the Pacific in late July 2026.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Landfall information issued by China's meteorological authorities, either directly or through contemporaneous reliable news coverage. Resolution Condition : Resolve to the city identified as the location of Dolphin's first mainland China landfall during August 2026. Offshore island landfalls do not count. Accepted Answer Format : Provide the city name, rather than its province or a broader geographical region.
questions.current_reasoning: Typhoon Dolphin (13th named storm of 2026) will not develop until late July, and roughly 35 mainland Chinese coastal prefecture-level cities can receive a first landfall in early August (offshore island landfalls like Hainan and Zhoushan are excluded). Under 2026's intensifying El Nino and peak early-August northward displacement of the subtropical high, East China coastal cities in southern Zhejiang and northern Fujian (Wenzhou, Taizhou, Fuzhou, Ningde) see elevated probabilities alongside climatological mainland leader Zhanjiang (Guangdong). Because probability is widely dispersed across ~35 coastal cities, the top 5 sum to an uninflated 0.36, leaving 64% on the rest of China's mainland coastal cities.

questions.title: If Novak Djokovic and Aryna Sabalenka play mixed doubles together at the 2026 US Open, which pair, if any, will eliminate them?
questions.background: The US Open mixed doubles tournament is a knockout competition featuring teams consisting of one male player and one female player.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official US Open match results, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the opposing pair that defeats Djokovic and Sabalenka in a completed match, eliminating them from the 2026 US Open mixed doubles tournament. If they do not compete together, withdraw without a completed defeat, or win the tournament, no pair qualifies. Accepted Answer Format : Both opposing players' surnames, joined by “and”; either order is acceptable.
questions.current_reasoning: As of June 24, 2026, the USTA has not yet announced entries for the revamped Aug 24-25 US Open Mixed Doubles Championship; Aryna Sabalenka only playfully hinted at teaming with Novak Djokovic in January, and Cincinnati finishes Aug 23 (creating high withdrawal/non-participation risk right before Fan Week, plus ~11% chance they win if they do play). Because the resolution criteria explicitly state 'no pair qualifies' if they do not compete together, withdraw without a defeat, or win the title, 'No pair qualifies' takes 65%. Conditional on playing and losing (~35%), the highest-probability opposing pairs are two-time defending mixed champions Sara Errani & Andrea Vavassori (5%), plus established 2025 star pairs Andreeva/Medvedev (who eliminated Djokovic in 2025 R1), 2025 finalists Swiatek/Ruud, and Shelton/Townsend, leaving 24% for all other unannounced 2026 teams.

questions.title: Which club will Rodri join from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window?
questions.background: Rodri is a midfielder for Manchester City.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements from the clubs involved, corroborated by reliable sports reporting. Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the receiving club in Rodri's first completed permanent transfer from Manchester City during the 2026 summer transfer window. Transfer rumours, bids, and agreements in principle do not qualify. Resolution Date : The date the completed transfer is officially announced. Accepted Answer Format : The receiving club's commonly used name.
questions.current_reasoning: Major 2026-07-24/26 Tier-1 shift (The Athletic via Hindustan Times/OneFootball/The Hard Tackle, TalkSport's Ben Jacobs & Mundo Deportivo/Sergio Valentín via Yahoo Sports): overturning earlier denials, The Athletic reports Real Madrid have moved Rodri to the centre of their summer transfer plans (prepared to offer a contract to 2030), are increasingly confident of reaching an agreement, and are 'operating on the basis that Rodri will be joining the club this summer.' Ben Jacobs adds Manchester City are bracing for a Madrid offer as Rodri wants to leave for football and family reasons, and Mundo Deportivo reports Rodri has given the green light to Madrid while his camp expects City to ask around €80m (versus €50m-€60m cited by AS/Jacobs with one year left on his deal). Zero competing club bids have emerged (Atletico just signed Lee Kang-in; Barcelona signed Anthony Gordon). Lifting Real Madrid from 0.48 -> 0.55 (capped at 0.55 since formal club-to-club talks have not yet begun, City still hope to keep him, and pending back surgery adds execution risk), trimming Atletico Madrid (0.15 -> 0.14), Barcelona (0.13 -> 0.11), PSG (0.10 -> 0.08), and Bayern Munich (0.04 -> 0.03), with 9% residual.

questions.title: Which prominent RSF field commander will Darfur's governor announce has been killed in western Sudan in early August 2026?
questions.background: The Rapid Support Forces (RSF) are a paramilitary group fighting Sudan's army in a war that began in April 2023.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the RSF field commander whose death in fighting in western Sudan Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi announces during August 1–10, 2026, according to Al Jazeera's reporting. The question concerns the governor's announcement, not independent confirmation of the death. Resolution Date : 2026-08-10 (announcement window: August 1–10, 2026) Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the commander's name, omitting military rank and nickname.
questions.current_reasoning: Following the RSF's brutal capture of El Fasher in late October 2025, fighting continues across North Darfur and western Sudan between RSF forces and Darfur Governor Minni Arko Minnawi's allied Joint Force. The highest-profile active RSF Darfur field commanders are UNSC-sanctioned North Darfur commander Gedo Hamdan Ahmed (Feb 2026), West Darfur commander Abdelrahman Juma Barakallah (Nov 2024), El Fasher field commanders Al-Fateh Abdullah Idris and Tijani Ibrahim Moussa Mohamed (both UNSC-sanctioned Feb 2026), and prominent North Darfur field commander Ali Rizqallah (omitting ranks and nicknames per format rules). Because over 15 other RSF field commanders operate in Darfur and Kordofan (e.g., Osman Mohamed Hamid, Hussein Barsham, Al-Nour Al-Quba), 53% of probability mass is properly left outside the top 5.
